changed: A bigger partner card on the main menu, and a softer selection highlight.
fixed: Menus scale up on large screens, the gacha screen keeps its shape on wide monitors, Esc works after using a drop-down, and the first press on a menu moves from the highlighted entry.
Controller button prompts no longer flicker to the keyboard's when Steam Input or another remapper is running.

new: The arrow keys move through the menus and Esc goes back, like a gamepad's D-pad and B.
changed: A whole new look: pixel windows across every menu and in-run screen, and your partner talks you through the main menu. Settings → About now credits everyone behind the game, music included.
Controller button prompts are twice as big and easier to read, in the menus and in runs.

new: What's new: a new button on the main menu lists every update. A dot shows when there's one you haven't read.
The results screen shows what your achievements paid out, in solo and co-op.
Pick the manual-aim crosshair's colour and size in Settings → Controls.
Play the menus with a gamepad: the D-pad or stick moves through every menu and level-up choice, and button prompts match your controller.
changed: HUD size is Auto by default and grows with the window, or pick a fixed size from 75% to 200%.
The crosshair is magenta by default and no longer changes colour while you fire.
In co-op, when a teammate goes down or leaves, their enemies now come for you gradually over 10–20 seconds instead of all at once.
Server updates no longer close multiplayer lobbies: you reconnect to the same room automatically. Games in progress still finish as before.
fixed: The HUD size slider can be dragged all the way again.
behindTheScenes: Each release now gets a version number, shown in Settings, and a changelog.

new: The in-run HUD grows on large screens, and Settings → Graphics has a HUD size option.
changed: Enemy healers are weaker: they heal only part of the damage you deal, fewer enemies at a time, and never bosses or shielded enemies.
Healed enemies show a heal effect, so you can see who's being healed.
fixed: Reward menus ignore clicks and keys for a moment after they appear, so you can't pick a reward by accident.

new: Manual aim on desktop: a crosshair follows the mouse, and holding the left button (or the right trigger) fires even with no enemy in range.
behindTheScenes: The original game's code was retired and automated checks are faster.

new: Manual aim: point your attacks with the mouse, a second touch stick or the gamepad's right stick. Switch with T, the AIM button or Settings → Controls.
changed: Enemy shields are weaker, last less long and cover fewer enemies, and a blue bar shows how much shield is left.

new: PokéSurvivor is here: survive waves of wild Pokémon with your partner, alone or in co-op with up to 3 friends.
A personality test picks your first partner. Collect over 900 Pokémon and their shinies through the gacha.
Level up during a run to learn, upgrade and evolve moves, pick up held items and form bonds.
Rifts lead to legendary arenas, and weather, events, chests and altars change every run.
Spend PokéCoins on permanent upgrades, including move bans and move slots.
Daily and weekly missions, achievements, leaderboards and friends.
Resume a solo run after closing the tab or reloading.
Play with a keyboard and mouse, a gamepad, or touch on phones and tablets.
behindTheScenes: Rebuilt from the ground up: the server runs co-op games and keeps your progress in your account.
